about_the_game:
This game is the spiritual sequel to "除邪(CHUXIE)". This time it will adopt a third-person perspective. You will play the role of an apprentice exorcist born into a Taoist family. Carrying a peach wood sword, you embark on a journey to slay demons and monsters, and go deep into the forest to search for clues of missing people.

Deep in a dense forest shrouded in perpetual fog, time and direction blur. Every twisted shadow harbors a hidden threat, and every unnatural sound pokes at your nerves. Relying on courage and wit, you must survive this cursed fog and uncover the horrifying truth behind the disappearances.

Gameplay

Enter the dark forest or village, search for clues to missing persons, solve numerous puzzles, face fear, and use peach wood swords or firearms to fight against terrifying monsters

Game Key

- Advanced movement system allows players to control their characters and engage in combat with a smooth experience.

- A chilling horror experience, with spatial sound effects and realistic graphics that make you feel like you're right there.

- Intense combat, players will face numerous terrifying, oppressive creatures, defeating them with a wooden sword and limited ammunition.

- Monsters experience more realistic physical hit response.

- Exploration and challenge, players must explore the map to find clues and ammunition to solve puzzles, while also finding ways to defeat powerful special enemies.

- Character costumes that can be collected and changed through the map.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 | AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 | AMD Radeon™ RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound compatible（DirectX 9.0c or higher）
  • Additional Notes: SSD hard drive
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K | AMD Ryzen 5 3600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® 2070RTX | AMD Radeon™ RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound compatible（DirectX 9.0c or higher）
  • Additional Notes: SSD hard drive

short_description: This time the player will play the role of a trainee exorcist,and her first task is to find missing persons.It seems like a simple task,but she has no idea what a terrifying and unimaginable existence she is about to face.
